reason: The membrane specimen needs to reach the flight locker for the journey home, so placing it there directly advances that goal.
expectation: I expect the first specimen to be secured in the locker, though there may be another step needed.

alternatives.reason: Harvesting lettuce looks like the way to take some of the garden along, but I want to secure the specimen first.

effect: The specimen is now at the flight locker, completing that goal. I can turn to the garden.
reaction: It was a straightforward placement; nothing notable.
reason: Cutting leaves from the lettuce trough looks like the available way to take some of the garden along.
expectation: I expect to harvest lettuce leaves that I can take to the flight galley, though another step may be needed.

effect: The harvest produced departure lettuce leaves, ready to take to the flight galley.
reaction: The result was straightforward; nothing notable.
reason: Putting the leaves in the flight galley is the only available combination and appears to advance the remaining garden goal.
expectation: I expect the lettuce to be prepared or stored for the journey, completing the garden goal.

effect: The leaves became a meal for the flight, completing the garden goal and the chapter.
reaction: The meal box clicking shut was a satisfying, quiet way to carry something from the garden home.

mostWorthwhile.text: Packing the fresh meal was the most worthwhile moment: the handful of leaves connects the departure to the garden that was kept alive through the storm.

leastWorthwhile.text: Harvesting the leaves was straightforward and produced no further detail on its own.

surprise.text: I expected the leaves to be stored or prepared, and the result specified a washed meal packed in a box; there was no major surprise.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary, though placing the specimen in the locker was a simple, direct step.

continue.text: Yes. The specimen and frozen cores make me curious about what the receiving lab will find, although this chapter itself offered few decisions.
